newsitem.title: USA: Today's Man CEO personal reorganisation plan approved.
newsitem.headline: Today's Man CEO personal reorganisation plan approved.

text.p: David Feld, chairman and chief executive of Today's Man Inc, Thursday said that a federal Bankruptcy Court confirmed the plan of reorganization in his personal Chapter 11 reorganization case.

The plan, confirmed by the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of New Jersey, received overwhelming support from Feld's creditors, restructures his financial obligations and resolves all creditors' claims, a statement said.

In addition, successful confirmation and emergence from Chapter 11 protection preserves Feld's majority interest in Today's Man, the company he founded and built from one store to 25 menswear superstores in the Philadelphia, New York and Washington D.C. markets.

The company's Chapter 11 reorganization remains in its final stages, with an amended plan of reorganization filed with the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware and a disclosure hearing scheduled for August 21, 1997.
